planTitle: Prospective Frontier Model Corpus Acquisition Plan (2026+)
objective: Formulate a systematic acquisition, provenance qualification, and benchmark evaluation protocol for emerging frontier model families (e.g. GPT-5 / o3, Claude 4, Gemini 3, DeepSeek V4) to extend HumanizeText detection resilience without test leakage.

targetFrontierFamilies.focus: Deliberative test-time compute outputs, structured chain-of-thought summaries, advanced technical prose
Nuanced human-style pacing, self-correction traces, low cliché density
Multimodal synthesis transcripts, long-context corporate summaries, agentic workflow logs
Cost-optimized open-source enterprise outputs, localized and bilingual English generation

acquisitionProtocol.promptLineageTracking: Hash-linked prompt ID and system prompt recording
acquisitionProtocol.authorshipEvidence: Cryptographic API response logging with timestamp and model response headers
acquisitionProtocol.licensingPreclearance: Generated under commercial API terms allowing model evaluation and research benchmark dissemination
acquisitionProtocol.leakagePrevention: Strictly quarantined into TEMPORAL_CHALLENGE / FRONTIER_CHALLENGE partition. Zero inclusion in TRAIN, DEV, or CAL.

evaluationStrategy.quarantinedBenchmark: External challenge suite evaluated strictly after model freeze
metricReporting: Dense Recall at fixed 1% and 5% Human FPR
Selective Recall at tau_ai=0.65 with Abstention Rate
Distribution shift divergence (Wasserstein distance on 21 stylometric features vs V2.5 baseline)
